sources.title: HNEI Researcher Publishes 1st Ever Synthetic Training Datasets for AI ...
sources.snippet: HNEI Researcher Publishes 1st Ever Synthetic Training Datasets for AI Diagnosis of Li-ion Batteries HNEI Assistant Researcher Matthieu Dubarry and his team published a new study in the Journal of Power Sources. In this, they proposed, for the first time, synthetic training datasets for artificial intelligence lithium ion diagnosis and prognosis.
